metadata.note: Raw traces are downloaded into a local cache and are not committed. This file contains derived hit-rate curves and provenance.

reference_sources.label: BurstGPT
reference_sources.reason: Contains timestamps and token lengths but no block/prefix identity, so it should not drive cache hit-rate curves.

reference_sources.label: SwissAI Serving Trace
reference_sources.reason: Useful for serving-token distribution; bucketized token traces should only become hit-rate traces when identity semantics are explicit.

mooncake_fast25.label: Mooncake FAST25 Tool&Agent Trace
mooncake_fast25.sourceBlockSizeNote: hash_ids align with 512-token Mooncake blocks; the last block is weighted by the input-length remainder.

ragpulse.label: RAGPulse
ragpulse.sourceBlockSizeNote: RAGPulse exposes categorized hash_ids; v2 namespaces categories and weights token counts across the listed ids.

lmcache_agentic_sample.label: LMCache Agentic Traces
lmcache_agentic_sample.sourceBlockSizeNote: message text is normalized and hashed into estimated 64-token buckets; source does not publish block hash ids.

bailian_qwen_trace_a.label: Qwen Bailian Trace A
bailian_qwen_trace_a.sourceBlockSizeNote: published as qwen_traceA_blksz_16.jsonl; hash_ids are 16-token buckets.

semianalysis_weka_no_subagents.label: Weka Claude Code
semianalysis_weka_no_subagents.sourceBlockSizeNote: Claude Code request hash_ids are source-native 64-token blocks; hash ids are local to each trace.

semianalysis_weka_with_subagents_256k.label: Weka Claude Code + Subagents
semianalysis_weka_with_subagents_256k.scenario: Agentic coding hash trace with sub-agent fan-out
semianalysis_weka_with_subagents_256k.sourceBlockSizeNote: Claude Code main-agent and sub-agent requests use source-native 64-token local hash ids; rows above 256k proxy tokens are filtered by the source dataset.

kv_cache_tester_claude_code.label: kv-cache-tester Claude Code
kv_cache_tester_claude_code.scenario: Agentic coding trace replay hash corpus
kv_cache_tester_claude_code.sourceBlockSizeNote: The trace replay corpus stores one input hash id per 64-token block; sub-agent inner requests share the parent trace namespace.
